lessons.title: Oxygen: Cash Flow Management
lessons.quiz_source_title: Why Cash is Oxygen for Business Survival

lessons.title: April Cash Timing (Deep-Dive)
lessons.intro: Profit and cash diverge most sharply at month boundaries. April Cash Timing is a worked deep-dive showing how a profitable April can still produce a negative cash month when receivables stretch and payables tighten on the same calendar week.

equations.name: Cash gap
equations.note: Negative gap weeks = your runway risk weeks.

lessons.title: Five Economic Moats
lessons.quiz_source_title: Economic Moats & Five Types of Moats

lessons.title: Porter's Five Forces
lessons.quiz_source_title: Moats, Five Forces, and VRIO Strategy

lessons.title: Portfolio Strategy (Deep-Dive)
lessons.intro: Portfolio Strategy is how a multi-product company decides where to invest, where to harvest, and where to divest. The BCG Matrix is the canonical frame; the operating logic is allocating finite capital to the highest-return option.

equations.name: Capital weight
equations.note: Allocate next-period capital proportional to w_i.

lessons.title: Positioning & Focus (Deep-Dive)
lessons.intro: Positioning & Focus is the leadership discipline of saying no to good opportunities so the team can win on the few that matter. Most teams fail not from lack of opportunity but from spreading thin.

lessons.title: Velocity of Decision / Decide and Commit
Architecting Human Systems / Culture by Design
Channel Strategy (Deep-Dive)
lessons.intro: Channel Strategy is how you choose where customers find, evaluate, and buy from you. The right channel matches your customer's natural information-seeking behavior — not your sales team's preference.

lessons.title: Product-Market Fit (Deep-Dive)
lessons.intro: Product-Market Fit is the moment customers pull the product from you faster than you can push it. Before fit, growth is friction. After fit, growth is leverage. Knowing exactly which side you are on is the founder's primary job.

lessons.title: Loyalty Loops / The Evolution of Growth (Deep-Dive)
lessons.intro: Loyalty Loops are how growth compounds. Where a funnel ends with the sale, a loop ends with a referral or retention event that becomes the start of the next acquisition. Loops are the difference between linear and exponential growth.

equations.name: Viral coefficient
equations.note: i = invites per user; c = conversion of invites. k > 1 = compounding.

lessons.title: Integrated Marketing Mix
lessons.audio_overview_script: Retention is the unsung hero of unit economics. CAC gets you a customer once; retention turns one customer into ten purchases. This lesson breaks down churn, cohort lenses, and the leverage points that compound LTV without spending more on acquisition.

lessons.title: Automation Stack / Micro to Macro Scale (Deep-Dive)
The Quality Engine
lessons.quiz_source_title: The Quality Engine & Six Sigma Engine

lessons.title: Modern Tech Strategy
lessons.quiz_source_title: Stop Bolting Tech Onto Broken Operations

lessons.title: Dashboards (Deep-Dive)
lessons.intro: Dashboards are the operating system of the business. Done right, they replace meetings with shared real-time truth. Done wrong, they bury signal in noise.

lessons.title: Value Creation Journey / Capital Allocation
lessons.quiz_source_title: How to Scale Without Going Bankrupt

lessons.title: Marketing Funnel Fundamentals
lessons.quiz_source_title: Stop Burning Cash on Leaky Funnels

lessons.title: Brand Positioning & Messaging
lessons.intro: Brand Positioning & Messaging is the discipline of choosing the one place in the customer's mind you intend to own. Positioning precedes copy; copy carries the position.
lessons.quiz_source_title: Own One Word in Your Category

lessons.title: Pricing Strategy
lessons.intro: Pricing Strategy is the highest-leverage lever in the business. A 1% pricing change drops 8-10% to operating profit on average — more than any other operational change.

equations.name: Price elasticity
equations.note: |E| < 1 = inelastic, raise price. |E| > 1 = elastic, defend price.

lessons.title: Content & Demand Generation
lessons.intro: Content & Demand Generation is how you create awareness and intent at scale. The discipline is matching content depth to buyer stage and channel native format.

equations.name: Content ROI
equations.note: Track content-level pipeline contribution, not just impressions.

lessons.title: Customer Retention & Loyalty
lessons.intro: Customer Retention & Loyalty is where the business model proves itself. Acquiring a customer is expensive; keeping one is profitable. Retention is the largest single driver of LTV and the compound interest of the business.

equations.name: NRR
equations.latex: \text{NRR} = \frac{\text{Period revenue from existing cohort}}{\text{Prior-period revenue from same cohort}}

lessons.title: Supply Chain & Inventory Management
lessons.audio_overview_script: Theory of Constraints meets daily operations. The Buffer Paradox: adding slack (time, inventory, capacity) makes a system more reliable and faster overall — not slower. Why high-utilization systems break, where to put buffers, how to size them.
lessons.intro: Supply Chain & Inventory Management is the circulatory system of any physical business. The art is balancing resilience (inventory buffers) against the working capital cost of holding stock.

equations.name: Inventory turns
equations.note: Industry benchmark varies; track trend not absolute.

lessons.quiz_source_title: The Raw Mechanics of Business Resilience

lessons.title: Quality Management & Six Sigma
lessons.audio_overview_script: Operations Excellence is the discipline of making the standard the default. Not perfection — repeatability. SOPs, rhythms, metrics, and the cultural muscle of getting the same good result every time.

lessons.title: Project & Program Management
lessons.intro: Project & Program Management turns strategy into shipped outcomes. A project is one finite output; a program is a portfolio of projects driving a strategic theme. Both fail for the same reasons: unclear scope, weak ownership, no governance.

equations.name: Schedule variance
equations.note: Earned vs. planned value. Negative = behind.

lessons.title: Vendor & Partnership Management
lessons.intro: Vendor & Partnership Management is leveraged operations. Your suppliers and partners are extensions of your team — managed deliberately, they multiply capability; managed reactively, they become risk.
lessons.quiz_source_title: Your MBA Rock Curriculum Owner's Manual

lessons.title: Data-Driven Decision Making
lessons.quiz_source_title: Analytics for Decision Speed and Risk

lessons.title: KPIs & Performance Dashboards
lessons.intro: KPIs & Performance Dashboards make the business observable. The discipline is choosing the right metrics, defining them sharply, and reviewing them on the right cadence.

lessons.title: A/B Testing & Experimentation
lessons.intro: A/B Testing & Experimentation replaces opinions with evidence. Done right, it compounds learning. Done wrong, it confuses noise for signal and burns trust in data.

equations.name: Sample size
equations.note: Rough rule for two-arm equal-allocation test.

lessons.title: Forecasting & Scenario Planning
lessons.intro: Forecasting & Scenario Planning are how leaders make decisions under uncertainty. Forecasts narrow uncertainty; scenarios prepare you for the uncertainty that remains.

lessons.title: Risk Management & Mitigation
lessons.intro: Risk Management & Mitigation is the discipline of seeing what could go wrong before it does. Done well, it is the founder's most underrated leverage point.

equations.name: Risk score
equations.note: Likelihood × Impact. Threshold for board-level review = top quartile.

lessons.title: Disruption & The Innovator's Dilemma
lessons.intro: Disruption & The Innovator's Dilemma explains why successful companies often lose to inferior new entrants. The mechanism is rational decision-making at the incumbent that locks them out of the future market.

lessons.title: AI & Emerging Technology Strategy
lessons.intro: AI & Emerging Technology Strategy is how you make explicit bets on technology shifts that may or may not reshape your industry. The wrong move is ignoring; the second-wrong move is over-investing too early.
lessons.quiz_source_title: Weaponize AI, ESG, and the Innovators Dilemma

lessons.title: Sustainability & ESG Strategy
lessons.intro: Sustainability & ESG Strategy is no longer optional. Customers, investors, employees, and regulators all weight ESG in their decisions. The discipline is integrating it into operations without losing focus on the core business.

lessons.title: The Future-Ready Leader (Capstone)
lessons.intro: The Future-Ready Leader is the capstone synthesis: you have a financial OS, a strategy, a team, a growth engine, operations, capital, brand, execution discipline, decision frameworks, and a view of the future. Now lead.
